stories.title: NEWS CENTER Maine Weather Forecast
stories.summary: Another round of rain Friday night, then a quieter weekend. Plan for more rain Monday.

stories.title: Portland holds its annual tree lighting downtown
stories.summary: With the countdown to the holidays underway, NEWS CENTER Maine asked people for their favorite traditions.

stories.title: Van fire in Westbrook injures occupant, Fire Marshal reports
stories.summary: A van in Westbrook caught fire when its owner accidentally set a camp stove alight, igniting a nearby mattress and damaging DHL vehicles.

stories.title: Fire Marshal: Electrical failure burns down home in T1 R9 WELS
stories.summary: An electrical failure destroyed a house in T1 R9 WELS near Millinocket, but no injuries were reported, according to the Fire Marshal's Office.

stories.title: Three-car crash in Windham injures drivers, investigation ongoing
stories.summary: A three-car crash temporarily closed Roosevelt Trail, officials report.

stories.title: Sugarloaf Mountain opens for ski season
stories.summary: Sugarloaf Mountain has joined Maine's winter sport season, opening its lifts and trails to skiers, following Sunday River's lead earlier this week.

stories.title: Plaid-clad shoppers score deals at Bangor’s Black Friday alternative
stories.summary: Shoppers dressed in plaid get discounts at nearly 20 downtown Bangor stores, a local twist that owners say helps small businesses compete during the holiday.

stories.title: Maine Christmas tree growers navigate drought, rising costs as they open for holiday season
stories.summary: Despite a challenging growing season and increased production costs, Maine farmers and families are keeping their Christmas tree traditions alive.

stories.title: Black Friday shoppers head to Freeport for holiday deals
stories.summary: From Maine residents to out-of-state visitors, shoppers flocked to Freeport's outlets and L.L.Bean stores to get a jump on their Christmas shopping.

stories.title: Police investigate shooting involving juvenile in Lewiston
stories.summary: The juvenile was taken to Central Maine Medical Center and later transferred to Maine Medical Center for further treatment.

stories.title: Bangor Fire Department hands out new badges
stories.summary: Bangor welcomed five firefighters and seven medics and honored five promotions. The new medics help keep the city's Rescue 2 unit running around the clock.

stories.title: Tractor-trailer crashes, leaks fuel in New Sharon
stories.summary: No injuries were reported after the truck crossed into the oncoming lane and went off Mile Hill Road Friday morning.
